# LinkedIn Lead Finder and Analyser

> Agent-driven LinkedIn research workspace that sources, analyses and briefs on prospects.

Author: Muhammad Tanveer (Full-Stack AI Automation Engineer)
Contact: mtanveertahir66@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-tanveer-advenno/
Repository: https://github.com/haddindeve/linkedin-lead-finder-and-analyser
Source availability: implementation held in a private repository; access on request.

## Summary
Researching a prospect on LinkedIn - profile, company, recent activity, fit - takes ten to fifteen minutes per lead and is done differently by each person doing it.

A command-driven research workspace: defined commands for sourcing, research and briefing, so the same steps run in the same order every time. The output is a structured brief rather than a pile of raw profile text.

## Stack
Automation: Agent command workflows, Research: LinkedIn profile and company analysis, Output: Structured prospect briefs

## Capabilities
- Repeatable research commands
- Prospect sourcing and shortlisting
- Fit analysis against a target profile
- Structured briefs instead of raw notes

## Outcomes
- Per-prospect research reduced to a single command
- Consistent output regardless of who runs it

## FAQ
Q: What does it produce?
A: A structured brief per prospect - profile summary, company context and fit assessment.

Q: Is it a scraper?
A: Sourcing is one step; the value is the analysis and briefing built on top.

Q: Can the research steps be changed?
A: Yes - the workflow is defined as commands that can be edited or extended.

Q: Is the code available?
A: Private; access on request.
